problem: TAGX live-quotes snapshot remained at 06:04 ET near the 08:00 ET cycle even though the live quote workflow declared a nominal 5-minute schedule. Existing cadence keeper monitored discovery.json only, so live quote freshness could silently fail while point-in-time dataConfidence remained HIGH from an old snapshot.

before.operationalGap: No independent wall-clock watchdog directly dispatched tagx-live-quotes.yml when live-quotes.json became stale.

logic: Check discovery and live-quotes ages independently during U.S. extended/regular session window.
Dispatch proactive discovery when discovery age >= 4 minutes.
Dispatch tagx-live-quotes.yml directly when live quote age >= 7 minutes.
Add TAGX Premarket Hot Heartbeat as an additional successful workflow_run trigger.
Keep trading decisions fail-closed; watchdog is only a recovery trigger.

benchmark.baseline: Nominal 5-minute live scheduler with upstream workflow_run dependencies could leave a >100 minute stale snapshot.
benchmark.challenger: Independent freshness watchdog with 7-minute direct-dispatch threshold.
benchmark.expectedMetric: Reduce live-feed stale-window duration and stale-snapshot exposure; no claim yet of improved Early-Capture Rate.

reasonNoVersionBump: This is data freshness/recovery infrastructure; ranking logic is unchanged.
safety: Old HIGH confidence is not equivalent to current freshness. TAGX must continue to reject actionable output when the snapshot is stale.
